description: This file defines the top-level structure of the curriculum, including superblocks, stages, and related functions for managing curriculum data in a learning platform.

methods.name: getStageOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of curriculum stages, optionally including upcoming changes based on configuration.

methods.name: generateSuperBlockList
methods.description: Generates a list of superblocks based on the current stage order and configuration.

methods.name: getAuditedSuperBlocks
methods.description: Returns the list of superblocks that have been audited for a specified language, excluding not audited ones.
